defects.justification: verifyPassword calls crypto.scryptSync on every /login request, unauthenticated requests for unknown users included (dummy hash). That blocks the single event loop for each attempt, so a modest login flood from several IPs stalls all users; it should use async crypto.scrypt.
hashPassword uses synchronous scryptSync in the /signup request path, which blocks the event loop on every unauthenticated signup. It should use the async scrypt.
